cues: Two phrases carry the whole essay.
Status equality: everyone counts as an equal person, with the same dignity and legal rights, as in the Universal Declaration's first article; ending slavery or caste discrimination are examples.
Distributive equality: everyone has a fair share, or at least there is a limit on how large the gap can grow, as when taxes narrow it.
It does not have the second.
